title: Stalk Seed

{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Stalk Seed |Crop = Monster Fruit |Growth = 25 days |Season = {{Season|Summer}} |Sell Price = 0 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |jPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Summer}}. Mature plants yield [[Monster Fruit]] after 25 days. Seeds cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by eliminating [[Wilderness Golems]] in [[The Highlands]] and by placing Monster Fruit in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Monster Fruit per harvest with a 7% chance of extra harvest per each [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Monster Fruit}} {{clear}}
